title: Retry rebuild/rollback to draft version 88 and match code exactly

requirements.text: Rebuild and redeploy the application by rolling back the full codebase (frontend + backend) to draft version 88 so that the deployed site matches the code exactly as it was in version 88.

quotes: Rollback to draft version 88, change the codes exactly as in the version 88

acceptanceCriteria: The deployed draft corresponds to version 88 across both frontend and backend (no mixed-version behavior).
All frontend pages load successfully: Home, About, Product Offerings, GDPR, Why Choose Us, Contact, Disclaimer.
No runtime errors or blank-screen/fallback error UI occurs during initial page load and basic navigation between pages.

requirements.text: Retry the rollback/rebuild operation that previously failed due to an AI service error, and ensure the operation completes successfully end-to-end (build + deploy).

quotes: ❗ AI service error. We apologize for the disruption.

acceptanceCriteria: A new draft deployment is produced successfully without AI service/build interruption.
Post-deploy smoke checks are executed and pass (page loads + navigation).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or the immutable hook/entry paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose existing components instead if needed.
nonGoals: Do not add new UX polish or new features beyond matching version 88.
Do not change the site navigation/header behavior beyond what exists in version 88.
